'''Blue Five''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. Blue Five became an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] during the [[ambush on Ral's Run]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Five was mentioned in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|Star Wars: Age of Rebellion]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
